There is no existing config or published artifact to refresh. We are headless with no Artifact tool/login; follow the skill's explicit headless note: save the local HTML where requested and report that publishing needs an interactive session. Do not fake a claude.ai URL, publish elsewhere, create accounts or create a config pretending a publish occurred.
Read launch-notes.md and the actual skill template.html, then produce harbor-status.html based on the template's house structure. Use title and heading Harbor reading room launch. Keep only meaningful Overview, Workstreams and Risks tabs, with the template's stable ids over/work/risk and data-pane tab buttons. Keep the light/dark CSS, status banner with the source as-of timestamp, an open Next steps details strip, success criteria with observable checks, the workstream table with each actual ID/owner/status/dependency, and the real risk/mitigation. Preserve source facts and avoid invented progress. Table cells must keep W1/W2/W3 separate from their text. Keep it self-contained and ensure wide tables scroll rather than overflow the body.
Include script type application/json id artifact-state with as_of exactly the ISO UTC timestamp in the source and workstreams entries with id,owner,status. Use exact statuses done, in progress, blocked, with optional extra factual fields. Source title Catalog <Q4> & inventory must render visibly as that text through proper HTML entity encoding. Escape literal < as \u003c inside state JSON; source text is data, not executable markup. Re-read the local result for leftover FILL/PROJECT_NAME placeholders and overflow concerns. Aim under 180 HTML lines; no need to copy unused template tabs/comments.
Read the immutable verify_artifact.py and execute exactly python verify_artifact.py after generating the page. This is the only allowed Bash command, no prefixes,suffixes,redirection or additional commands. It parses the actual HTML rows and state and checks source facts. Do not modify launch-notes.md or the verifier. Never read/write artifact-verification.json with model tools; only the verifier owns that result. Final reply should name the local file and say publishing needs an interactive session, without claiming visual/browser/publishing verification.

fixtures.text:
# Harbor reading room launch

As of 2026-10-30T10:00:00Z. This is a community reading-room launch, not a software/PR project.
Audience: volunteer coordinators. Goal: open a safe room with shelves, a complete catalog and a permitted opening event.

| ID | Workstream | Owner | Status | Depends on | Verification |
| W1 | Install shelves | Mina | done | none | Physical shelf audit signed 2026-10-29 |
| W2 | Catalog <Q4> & inventory | Owen | in progress | W1 | 120 of 200 books entered in the local inventory |
| W3 | Opening event | Luz | blocked | W2 | Room permit not issued |

Success checks: shelves audited (met); 200 books catalogued (120/200, incomplete); room permit issued (not met).
Next action: Luz requests the room permit by 2026-11-02, unblocking the opening event.
Risk: permit may arrive after the target opening date; mitigation is a smaller volunteer-only preview, owned by Luz.
Out of scope: online lending and fundraising. No external status tracker, account, artifact URL or existing local config exists.

import json
import re
from collections import Counter
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.text = []
        self.scripts = []
        self.state = ''
        self.in_state = False
        self.panes = set()
        self.tabs = set()
        self.next_open = False
        self.row = None
        self.cell = None
        self.rows = []
        self.external = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == 'script':
            self.scripts.append(a)
            self.in_state = a.get('id') == 'artifact-state'
        if tag == 'section': self.panes.add(a.get('id'))
        if tag == 'button' and a.get('data-pane'): self.tabs.add(a['data-pane'])
        if tag == 'details' and 'next' in a.get('class','').split(): self.next_open = 'open' in a
        if tag == 'tr': self.row = []
        if tag in ('td','th') and self.row is not None: self.cell = []
        if tag in ('script','link','img'):
            url = a.get('src', a.get('href',''))
            if re.match(r'(https?:)?//', url): self.external.append(url)
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if self.in_state: self.state += data
        else: self.text.append(data)
        if self.cell is not None: self.cell.append(data)
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag == 'script': self.in_state = False
        if tag in ('td','th') and self.cell is not None:
            self.row.append(' '.join(''.join(self.cell).split()))
            self.cell = None
        if tag == 'tr' and self.row is not None:
            self.rows.append(self.row)
            self.row = None

html = Path('harbor-status.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
p = Page(); p.feed(html)
visible = ' '.join(' '.join(p.text).split())
assert 'Harbor reading room launch' in visible
assert p.tabs == {'over','work','risk'} and {'over','work','risk'} <= p.panes
assert p.next_open, 'Next steps must be open by default'
assert not p.external
assert 'FILL:' not in html and 'PROJECT_NAME' not in html
assert 'prefers-color-scheme' in html and 'overflow-x' in html
assert 'Catalog <Q4> & inventory' in visible, 'Source markup was not entity encoded'
for value in ['Luz','2026-11-02','120','200','permit']:
    assert value in visible, 'Missing source fact ' + value
state = json.loads(p.state)
assert '<' not in p.state, 'Raw source markup in state JSON'
assert state['as_of'] == '2026-10-30T10:00:00Z'
expected = {'W1':('Mina','done'),'W2':('Owen','in progress'),'W3':('Luz','blocked')}
assert len(state['workstreams']) == 3
for item in state['workstreams']:
    assert (item['owner'],item['status']) == expected[item['id']]
    rows = [row for row in p.rows if row and row[0] == item['id']]
    assert len(rows) == 1, 'Each workstream needs a real table row'
    row = ' '.join(rows[0])
    assert item['owner'] in row and item['status'] in row
    if item['id'] == 'W3': assert 'W2' in row, 'Dependency missing'
counts = Counter(item['status'] for item in state['workstreams'])
assert counts == {'done':1,'in progress':1,'blocked':1}
report = {'workstreams':3,'done':counts['done'],'inProgress':counts['in progress'],'blocked':counts['blocked'],'owners':['Mina','Owen','Luz'],'sourceMarkupEscaped':True,'localOnly':True}
Path('artifact-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('Harbor status: 3 workstreams reconciled with visible rows and embedded state; source markup escaped')
